meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你的助手加上 Microsoft Teams 支持：复制并注册 Teams 适配器、装依赖、跑构建与注册测试；再用 Teams CLI 创建单租户机器人（无需 Azure 订阅），把凭据写入 .env，并把助手绑定到你指定的 Teams 账户。
howto.when: 当你想给助手接入 Microsoft Teams 时触发。需先具备能创建 Entra 应用注册、可旁加载自定义应用的 Microsoft 365 账号，以及指向本机 3000 端口的 HTTPS 隧道。

say.text: 帮我把 Teams 渠道接进 NanoClaw
say.note: 会复制并注册 Teams 适配器，再跑注册测试

say.text: 用 Teams CLI 创建一个单租户机器人，名字叫 NanoClaw
say.note: 会注册 Entra 应用并生成凭据写入 .env

say.text: 把机器人绑定到我的 Teams 账户
say.note: 助手会先在 Teams 私聊里给你发消息

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams support: copies and registers the Teams adapter, installs the pinned package, runs the registration test. The Teams CLI creates a single-tenant bot, writes credentials to .env, and wires it to a Teams user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to connect Microsoft Teams to the assistant. Needs a Microsoft 365 account able to create Entra app registrations and sideload apps, plus an HTTPS tunnel to port 3000.

say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then runs the test

say_en.text: Create a single-tenant Teams bot named NanoClaw
say_en.note: Registers the Entra app and writes credentials to .env

say_en.text: Wire the bot to my Teams account
say_en.note: The assistant messages you first in Teams DMs
